task_card.title: Object Stamp Flow - extract an object from one image, place it into another

next_action.description: Read brief.md then prompts.md, then author the graph on the standalone bench (port 8188, NOT the app engine on 48188): Draw It In's flow_draw_it_in.json topology with the object in place of the scribble - composite -> InpaintCropImproved -> Klein 9B edit -> ColorMatch -> InpaintStitchImproved. Both Auto and Manual are the SAME graph; only the two reference slots and the baked prompt differ. Settle crop sizing there before any app-side work.

key_decisions: It stays a SEPARATE flow rather than folding into Draw It In - MPI-621 predicted convergence, but the Auto/Manual split has no equivalent there and the two serve different users (rough intent vs an exact supplied object).

Auto/Manual is a REFERENCE-CONFIG switch, not two prompts. Auto: slot1 clean scene + slot2 stamped composite, object's own pixels, user's viewpoint kept. Manual: slot1 cropped scene + slot2 clean object full-frame, model picks the viewpoint. The canvas differs to match - Manual shows an empty box with NO rotation handle because rotation there would be a lie.
An auto-PLACEMENT mode was rejected: it would duplicate a 2-image Klein edit the user can already run in History, and the box is the flow's reason to exist.
The angle limitation is answered with hint copy (supply the object shot from roughly the angle you want), not engineering - same shape as MPI-567's 'upscale the source first'.
constraints: NEVER send three references. Three is the documented identity-mixing limit and live it drew TWO GUNS.

Identity and viewpoint are mutually exclusive: licensing a redraw is novel view synthesis, and the model has no 3D model of the user's object - a pose-described run returned a beautifully lit pistol that was NOT the user's Glock. This is WHY there are two modes; do not try to unify them.

Prompts must sit in the 40-120 word band (target 60-90). A 200-word version returned a hugely oversized cup. Hedging modifiers (approximately/roughly/near) do not constrain AND they dilute - each caused a measured failure.
The CLIP arm moves WITH the checkpoint: Klein 9B needs qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot, and Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name takes the DOTTED form while Input_Edit_Model stays plain (MPI-600).
A step gets exactly ONE media today (out.find(m => m.role === step.role), in BOTH _buildStepSlide and _deriveRunMedia) - hence the sourceRole addition.
bgMask and userMask must stay two layers composited only at dispatch, or toggling Remove Background destroys the user's erasures.
NEVER write preview/video into the FlowDef before the art files exist - it 404s and flows-tab-ring.spec.js asserts a clean console; that held master red for a day and eight pushes.
npm test green is NOT the CI gate - run npm run test:desktop too.
